title: VIDIIA Hunter diagnostic platform: a low-cost, smartphone connected, artificial intelligence-assisted COVID-19 rapid diagnostics approved for medical use in the UK.
summary: The VH6 system uses automated image acquisition and an embedded deep-learning image classifier to interpret RT-LAMP COVID-19 assays. Against RT-qPCR, final validation of 400 NHS samples yielded 98% sensitivity overall (100% in high viral-load samples) and 100% specificity; clinical and variant tests provide measured diagnostic performance.
ai_technology: An embedded deep-learning image classifier interpreted RT-LAMP assay images after automated image capture.
